title: The letter yod: value 10, ancient hand pictograph, Y and I
summary: Introduces the Hebrew letter yod (value 10, sounds Y or I) whose ancient pictograph is an arm and hand and means 'Hand, Work'. Arrows trace the ancient glyph into a later letterform and then into the Latin letters Y and I.

letters.meaning: hand, work (arm and hand pictograph); letter sound Y, I

numbers.note: numerical value of the letter yod

pictures.description: Ancient pictograph of the letter yod: a black arm and hand drawn as a bent horizontal arm with a small hand, underlined in orange, shown beside the words 'Hand, Work'.
Evolution chain in black: the large ancient arm-and-hand pictograph (orange underline), an arrow to a later upright yod-like letterform, an arrow to the Latin letters Y, I in red-brown.

uncertain: Three red-brown glyphs at the top (modern Hebrew yod, a second curved yod-like letterform, and a plain vertical bar) sit above a long horizontal line; their exact meaning was not clear.
The middle glyph in the arrow chain is a later upright letterform whose exact script was not identified.
